label: 02 — The idea
creed: Software should earn its place. I build small, sharp tools that solve one real problem well — then put them somewhere anyone can use them.

pillars.title: Ship it small
pillars.body: A tool that exists beats a platform that doesn't. Every project starts at the smallest version that's genuinely useful.

pillars.title: Open by default
pillars.body: Free to try, no signup wall before you understand what a thing does. Demos stay up.

pillars.title: Built to feel good
pillars.body: Speed, motion and clarity aren't decoration. They're the difference between a tool you use once and one you keep.
